annotations.title: Gross salary needed for a net amount in Morocco

description: The gross yearly salary in Morocco that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many MAD, for the euro amounts. Default 10.7 (indicative).

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

period.description: Whether net_target is per year or per month. Default year.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in MAD, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: gross_for_target_net
